use_conv2d_empty_tensor: use the Conv2d wrapper to handle empty tensor input in older PyTorch versions below 1.4
use_conv3d_empty_tensor: use the Conv3d wrapper to handle empty tensor input in older PyTorch versions below 1.4
use_convtranspose2d_deconv: use the ConvTranspose2d wrapper registered as deconv to handle empty tensor input for upsampling
use_maxpool2d_empty_tensor: use the MaxPool2d wrapper to handle empty tensor input in older PyTorch versions below 1.9
use_linear_empty_tensor: use the Linear wrapper to handle empty tensor input in older PyTorch versions below 1.6
